body.text:
This is your own plan: 20% safety, 70% core, 10% growth, ₹1,00,000 a month for 5 years. It replays real past months from 2015 to 2018, in blocks of about 12 months, 10,000 times.
Money put in over those years: ₹60,00,000.
Where it could end up: bad case ₹70,20,000, middle ₹1.02 Cr, good case ₹1.48 Cr.
After inflation, in today's rupees: bad case ₹55,30,000, middle ₹79,90,000, good case ₹1.16 Cr.
In 90% of paths the plan fell by 20% or more at some point. That is the fall you said you can sit through.
The typical worst fall was 21%, about ₹8,07,000 of the money held at the time.
In the middle case, the worst fall took about 7 months to get back.
This replays real past months. It is not a forecast.
